# MyWallet

> MyWallet is a free, private personal finance app for Android (12 and later) by MD Rahim. It keeps financial data on the phone: no bank logins and no ads. It works offline, and the website is in English and Bengali (বাংলা).

Key facts:
- Track bank accounts, credit cards, cash, mobile wallets and loans in one app, in any currency.
- Category budgets with a daily spending allowance, savings goals, bills and subscriptions, receipt scanning, tax reports and insights.
- Ask MyWallet: an AI assistant that runs on the phone and turns plain sentences into transactions. Questions are never sent to a cloud AI provider.
- Optional bank SMS auto-capture, processed on the phone.
- Shared accounts: invite family members to one account with a code that works once, for 7 days.
- Trips: a plan, a checklist, one trip fund and everyone's expenses, and at the end who pays whom, in as few payments as possible.
- Savings groups (somiti): rounds, whose turn it is, each member's deposits, late fines and loans to members, with reminders.
- Wishlist: a waiting period before you buy (longer for dearer things), then what the thing would really cost you: whether it fits this month after bills, how many days of usual spending and how many working days of pay. Buy it, save for it, wait longer or let it go.
- Apart from optional Google Drive backups, which go to the user's own Drive, shared accounts, trips and savings groups are the only financial data stored in the cloud, so their members can see them.
- App lock with fingerprint, the phone's screen lock or a PIN of its own; hide balances; screenshot protection; Google Drive backup; CSV and PDF export.
- Free to download and use. MyWallet Plus is an optional subscription sold through Google Play.

## Pages
- [Home](https://mywalletapp.online/): what MyWallet does, privacy, comparison with typical budget apps, FAQ
- [Help Center](https://mywalletapp.online/help/): 24 answers about accounts, sharing, trips and savings groups, the wishlist, privacy, multi-currency, backups and settings
- [Trip expense splitter](https://mywalletapp.online/tools/trip-split/): free web calculator. Add who went, what you spent and who paid. See who owes whom, settled in as few payments as possible. Runs in the browser, no sign-up ([বাংলা](https://mywalletapp.online/bn/tools/trip-split/))
- [Bill splitter](https://mywalletapp.online/tools/bill-split/): free web calculator. Split evenly or by what each person had, with tax, service charge and tip shared fairly. Runs in the browser, no sign-up ([বাংলা](https://mywalletapp.online/bn/tools/bill-split/))
- [Savings group calculator](https://mywalletapp.online/tools/somiti/): free web calculator. Who gets the pot and when in a rotating savings group, or what a group fund grows to. Runs in the browser, no sign-up ([বাংলা](https://mywalletapp.online/bn/tools/somiti/))
- [Currency converter](https://mywalletapp.online/tools/currency-converter/): free web calculator. Today’s rates for 160+ currencies, and a check on what the rate you’re offered really costs. Runs in the browser, no sign-up ([বাংলা](https://mywalletapp.online/bn/tools/currency-converter/))
- [Free tools](https://mywalletapp.online/tools/): all free money calculators on the site
- [Privacy Policy](https://mywalletapp.online/privacy/): how data is handled
- [Terms of Service](https://mywalletapp.online/terms/)
- [বাংলা (Bengali) site](https://mywalletapp.online/bn/)
